chapter: Marriage, family and the Capitol albums
title: No musical training and how she communicates in the studio
summary: She has no formal training and worked collaboratively with May, Cavanaugh and Levy.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: And this is based on your gift. You did not have any musical training?
No. When my parents took me to a singing teacher, they said I was too young and my voice would change, which it did not. So I never really had any musical training.

When you were in a studio, when you heard whatever you heard, were you able to say anything besides, “This isn’t it?” How do you communicate when you don’t have the technical training? How do you communicate with the people that are working with you?

If you have good people – like Billy May, Dave Cavanaugh, John Levy, and I, we all sat down together. It was no – it never occurred to me that it should be any different. This to me was the way it was supposed to be.
